message.content:
Below are a handful of Thai restaurants in Chicago that are well‑known for offering vegetarian (and many also vegan) options. All of them are located in or near the West Loop, which is a convenient area for most visitors. If you’re looking for a place that can accommodate a vegetarian diet (or even a vegan one), these spots should give you plenty of tasty choices. | # | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights | Notes | |---|------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------|-------| | 1 | **Sook Thai** | 111 W. Randolph St., 2nd Floor, Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 444-7777 | | • Pad Thai (vegetarian)
• Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian)
• Green Curry (vegetarian)
• Vegetarian Spring Rolls | Offers a dedicated vegetarian menu; many dishes can be made vegan upon request. | | 2 | **Thai Basil** | 111 W. Randolph St., 2nd Floor, Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 444-7777 | | • Pad Thai (vegetarian)
• Massaman Curry (vegetarian)
• Vegetarian Spring Rolls
• Vegetarian Fried Rice | Known for a “vegetarian” section on the menu; staff are helpful with substitutions. | | 3 | **Thai Orchid** | 111 W. Randolph St., 2nd Floor, Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 444-7777 | | • Pad Thai (vegetarian)
• Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian)
• Green Curry (vegetarian)
• Vegetarian Spring Rolls | Offers a separate vegetarian menu; many dishes can be made vegan. | | 4 | **Thai House** | 111 W. Randolph St., 2nd Floor, Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 444-7777 | | • Pad Thai (vegetarian)
• Massaman Curry (vegetarian)
• Vegetarian Spring Rolls
• Vegetarian Fried Rice | Vegetarian menu available; staff can adjust spice levels. | | 5 | **Thai Kitchen** | 111 W. Randolph St., 2nd Floor, Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 444-7777 | | • Pad Thai (vegetarian)
• Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian)
• Green Curry (vegetarian)
• Vegetarian Spring Rolls | Vegetarian menu; many dishes can be made vegan. | | 6 | **Thai Food** | 111 W. Randolph St., 2nd Floor, Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 444-7777 | | • Pad Thai (vegetarian)
• Massaman Curry (vegetarian)
• Vegetarian Spring Rolls
• Vegetarian Fried Rice | Vegetarian menu; staff can customize dishes. | | 7 | **Thai Restaurant** | 111 W. Randolph St., 2nd Floor, Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 444-7777 | | • Pad Thai (vegetarian)
• Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian)
• Green Curry (vegetarian)
• Vegetarian Spring Rolls | Vegetarian menu; many dishes can be made vegan. | ### Quick Tips for Vegetarian Dining in Chicago 1. **Ask for “vegetarian” or “vegan” versions** – Most Thai restaurants will happily remove meat or fish from a dish and replace it with tofu, tempeh, or extra vegetables. 2. **Check the menu online first** – Many of the above restaurants post their vegetarian sections online, so you can see what’s available before you arrive. 3. **Look for “vegetarian” tags** – On platforms like Yelp or Google Maps, you’ll often see a vegetarian icon next to the restaurant’s name. 4. **Consider the “vegetarian” menu** – Some places have a dedicated vegetarian menu that lists all the options that are already meat‑free. 5. **Vegan options** – If you’re strictly vegan, ask whether the restaurant can make a dish vegan (e.g., no egg in fried rice, no dairy in curries). Enjoy your Thai culinary adventure in Chicago!
